baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from death, through no indication, to hidden eating, collapse, and clarification.
baseline_models.mechanism: Death is complete but socially unread. A minute earth-creature consumes the support by hidden attrition; the resulting fall converts an accumulating material cause into a public sign.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the concealed state that the standing posture fails to disclose.
Indication by a mark makes the creature-mediated collapse an evidentiary route to the hidden fact.
Hidden creeping supplies an imperceptible causal process that can advance without being sensed.
The wood-eating earth-creature identifies the materially exact agent that removes the support.
Consumption as corrosion turns ordinary eating into progressive structural failure.
A disturbed, sounding fall externalizes what silent decay and death had concealed.
Emergence into clarity is the epistemic result produced by the physical collapse.

changed_reading.before: The death is simply announced and then noticed.
changed_reading.after: The death remains operationally hidden until incremental material decay removes a support; collapse transforms a local trace into shared knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The staff at word 13 stands between decreed death and the jinn's prolonged humiliating labor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The staff is simultaneously a physical prop, an image of driving, and an image of delay. It preserves a readable posture of command after life has ended, so a coercive arrangement outlasts its living commander until the prop is consumed.

activation_trace.role: The executed decree of death fixes the commander's living agency as already ended.
Delay names the staff as the material means by which recognition is postponed.
Driving with a staff gives the same prop a disciplinary role in the labor mechanism.
Remaining in place is the prolonged behavioral effect sustained by the unread posture.
Punitive pain identifies continued labor as coercive rather than neutral duration.
Humiliation marks the social degradation produced by obedience to an empty posture.

changed_reading.before: The staff is an incidental support beside a dead body.
changed_reading.after: The staff is a control-bearing prop: it delays disclosure and preserves the appearance of command, allowing degrading labor to continue without living authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The jinn become clear or come to clarity precisely through a sign that disproves their knowledge of the unseen.
baseline_models.mechanism: The concealed beings do not access a concealed fact by ontological status. Knowledge arrives through an external mark, so the ayah distinguishes being hidden from knowing what is hidden.

activation_trace.role: The hidden beings supply the status whose presumed epistemic privilege is tested.
What is screened from sight defines the disputed object of knowledge.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the capacity explicitly denied by the counterfactual.
A resolvable sign replaces status as the actual route to knowledge.
Uncovering marks the transition from presumed access to evidence-based recognition.

changed_reading.before: The clause only denies one fact to the jinn.
changed_reading.after: The clause states an evidence rule: concealed beings learn a concealed fact from a material sign, not from their concealed mode of being.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening tracks what enters and exits the earth and denies that even an atom-weight is absent from divine knowledge. That scale sharpens the focus contrast: the tiny underground process is unseen to creatures but never informationally absent.

activation_trace.role: Hidden creeping anchors the focus mechanism in an action below ordinary perception.
The wood-eating earth-creature localizes the microscopic process within the focus ayah.
Knowledge as disclosure frames the inventory of movements that creatures may miss.
Entry into another thing supplies the downward, interior movement echoed by hidden consumption.
Emergence outward completes the entry-exit tracking against which later disclosure is read.
Minute and dispersed particles establish the smallest scale as still fully accounted for.
Hiddenness is assigned to what escapes eyes, not to what escapes divine knowledge.
Manifest clarity in the record anticipates the focus movement from concealment to disclosure.

structural_cues: 34:2 inventories entry into and exit from earth alongside descent and ascent.
34:3 places every atom-weight in a manifest record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive vertical and microscopic tracking; I infer that this scale governs the unnoticed earth-creature process. A live alternative is that the opening states omniscience without specifically prefiguring the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts jinn ignorance with one accidental piece of evidence.
changed_reading.after: The focus locates creaturely ignorance inside a fully tracked micro-order: the event is hidden only relative to limited observers, while its smallest material stages remain known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier scoffers sarcastically offer to point others toward a man announcing re-creation, and the surah then asks them to see a possible fall as a sign. In the focus, an earth-creature becomes the effective indicator and a fall settles what prestigious observers could not know.

activation_trace.role: Effective indication in the focus is assigned to the creature-mediated material sign.
The body's fall is the decisive visible event that completes the indication.
The scoffers' claimed act of pointing supplies a sarcastic human counter-image to the creature's true indication.
The summons to ocular and inward seeing makes failed perception a recurring problem.
A visible sign establishes material events as legitimate disclosure rather than low-status noise.
A threatened downward fall prefigures falling as an event that forces recognition.

structural_cues: 34:7 uses the same indication root in a taunt.
34:9 joins seeing, a possible fall, and a sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated indication and fall language; I infer a prestige reversal in who successfully directs whom. The live alternative is simple lexical recurrence without a deliberate answer to the taunt.

changed_reading.before: The creature is merely the unlikely cause of discovery.
changed_reading.after: The lowly creature becomes the surah's successful guide: its sign answers failed and mocking human guidance by making a fall tell the truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding gifts display control over softened iron, calibrated connected work, molten copper, and fixed monumental vessels. The focus then reveals that this material order can depend on one organic support vulnerable to slow, hidden corrosion.

activation_trace.role: The wood-eater introduces an exact low-scale vulnerability into the material system.
Corrosive consumption supplies the failure process that engineered scale does not prevent.
The staff is the small load-bearing and disciplinary object on which the visible arrangement depends.
Softening against hardness supplies an image of extraordinary material tractability.
Iron and resistant solidity establish the durable material register later countered by eaten wood.
Measured planning makes the preceding manufacture an ordered engineered system.
Molten copper expands the system from worked iron to controlled industrial flow.
Fixed, rooted vessels supply monumental stability as the contrast to the falling body.

structural_cues: 34:10-13 moves from softened iron and measured links to molten copper and fixed cauldrons.
34:14 immediately narrows from monumental production to one staff and one eater.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material-scale contrast; I supply the systems arrow that a vast arrangement can hinge on a weak support. A live alternative is that the manufacture list catalogs gifts without intentionally foregrounding fragility.

changed_reading.before: The eaten staff is an isolated marvel in the death scene.
changed_reading.after: The eaten staff is the weak point of a monumental engineered order, exposing how apparent material mastery can depend on a small degradable support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context identifies jinn as makers working before Solomon under command and threat of punishment. It therefore specifies the focus's humiliating punishment as prolonged coerced production, while the staff's driving branch explains how the command posture remains legible.

activation_trace.role: Driving by a staff makes the prop a compact image of disciplinary command.
Prolonged remaining is the temporal burden imposed on the workers.
Punitive pain explicitly classifies that prolonged state as torment.
The concealed beings are identified as the laboring population in the preceding arrangement.
Purposeful work supplies the concrete activity later described as prolonged punishment.
Threatened punishment establishes the coercive sanction behind the work.
Repeated making and commands to work intensify the production setting immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 34:12 says the jinn work before him by permission and threatens deviation with torment.
34:13 repeats work around large manufactured objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work, command, threat, and the focus phrase prolonged humiliating punishment; I infer that the latter points back to coerced production. A live alternative is that the focus punishment is broader distress rather than the work itself.

changed_reading.before: The jinn remain in an unspecified humiliating punishment.
changed_reading.after: They remain at commanded production under a sanction whose living enforcer is already dead; the humiliation is labor prolonged by unread authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Iblis passage supplies a model in which supposition becomes effective through following despite the absence of coercive authority. Applied to the focus, the dead body contributes no living power; the workers' inference that command persists, together with the staff's support, reproduces its effects.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life removes the actual capacity of the apparent commander.
The delaying prop preserves the sensory premise on which mistaken obedience can continue.
The workers' continued remaining is the behavioral effect needing explanation.
Supposition and imagined certainty supply a belief that can become behaviorally consequential.
Following converts an unforced belief into sustained action.
The explicit absence of power or authority separates causal influence from actual coercive capacity.

structural_cues: 34:20 joins a fulfilled supposition to people following it.
34:21 denies Iblis coercive authority and frames the result as a test of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies influence without authority; I map that causal pattern onto the dead ruler's still-effective posture. A live alternative is that the Iblis passage concerns belief testing independently of the focus labor scene.

changed_reading.before: The corpse somehow continues to command because it remains upright.
changed_reading.after: The corpse commands nothing; authority survives as a worker-side inference, and belief plus a material prop lets a powerless posture continue producing labor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointed day cannot be deferred or advanced, while the focus staff carries a delay image. The resulting distinction is exact: the decree and death occur on time, but observers' recognition is postponed until the support fails.

activation_trace.role: The executed death decree fixes the event as accomplished rather than suspended.
Delay belongs to the staff and therefore to disclosure, not to the death itself.
Slow stopping and delay describe the costly duration created by late recognition.
Deferral to a later time is explicitly denied of the appointed event.
Advancing or preceding supplies the opposite temporal displacement, likewise denied.

structural_cues: 34:29 asks when the promise is due.
34:30 says its appointed day can be neither delayed by an hour nor advanced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immovable deadline and a focus object whose branch image is delay; I assign delay to observer knowledge rather than to the decreed event. The live alternative is that the lexical echo is accidental.

changed_reading.before: The staff appears to postpone Solomon's death.
changed_reading.after: Nothing postpones the death; the staff postpones only its social registration, sharply separating event time from disclosure time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later the angels say people worshipped the jinn, while the reader is told to reflect and reject the charge of jinnah. The focus becomes a demythologizing disclosure: concealed beings are themselves limited knowers, and mental covering belongs to those who confuse hidden status with hidden knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The concealed beings anchor the focus target whose epistemic prestige is dismantled.
Their coming into clarity turns the scene into disclosure about them as well as to them.
The unseen is the domain falsely inferred from the beings' own hiddenness.
Submissive worship supplies the inflated religious status that the focus scene punctures.
The same concealed beings are named as misplaced objects of devotion.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the demanded alternative to prestige-based inference.
Mental covering supplies a semantic mirror for observers whose judgment is obscured.

structural_cues: 34:41 identifies the jinn as objects of misplaced worship.
34:46 commands solitary or paired reflection and denies jinnah in the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared J-N-N inventory but distinct lexical senses; I use their adjacency as a rhetorical mirror, not as identity of meaning. A live alternative is no intentional root-play between the focus jinn and the later jinnah accusation.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a private failure within the jinn workforce.
changed_reading.after: The focus publicly strips occult prestige from the jinn: hidden beings are exposed as evidence-dependent, while unreflective observers display the deeper covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, the same throwing root describes God casting truth as knower of the unseen and unbelievers throwing claims at the unseen from afar. The focus supplies a third epistemic mode: a local contact process leaves a material sign that defeats remote projection.

activation_trace.role: Indication by a mark anchors the focus in evidence rather than projected assertion.
Contact corrosion supplies the local causal trace from which the hidden state is inferred.
Casting truth supplies authoritative projection joined to knowledge rather than distance.
The plural unseen is explicitly paired with the one who knows it.
Throwing from afar supplies the contrasting image of an unsupported claim launched toward its object.
The hidden domain becomes the target of speculation rather than established knowledge.

structural_cues: 34:48 joins casting truth to knowledge of the unseen.
34:53 reuses casting for claims aimed at the unseen from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired casting clauses; I place focus evidence between them as contact-based correction. A live alternative is that the final casting contrast targets speech alone and does not classify the creature's material sign.

changed_reading.before: The creature's eating is a curious way to reveal death.
changed_reading.after: The eating models grounded knowledge: local causal contact produces a sign, unlike claims projected at the unseen from epistemic distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending moves through panic, missed access, attempted reaching from afar, and a barrier. This sharpens the focus sequence into punitive belatedness: the jinn finally know after collapse, but knowledge arrives only after they have already spent the unrecoverable duration in labor.

activation_trace.role: Collapse is the irreversible threshold after which the hidden fact becomes undeniable.
Disclosure occurs only on the far side of that threshold.
The prolonged stay is the already-incurred cost that later knowledge cannot cancel.
Failure of apprehension and access supplies the terminal condition of being too late.
Reaching by extension supplies the desired access that distance now prevents.
A separating barrier turns delayed recognition into irreversible exclusion.
Separation between parties and desired objects formalizes the closure of access.

structural_cues: 34:51-52 moves from no escape to attempted reaching from a distant place.
34:54 ends with a barrier between people and what they desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a terminal pattern of access recognized after its loss; I infer the same cost structure in the focus's post-collapse knowledge. A live alternative is that the closing eschatological scene is analogous but not explanatory of the jinn's duration.

changed_reading.before: The collapse corrects ignorance and ends the episode.
changed_reading.after: The correction is itself timed as judgment: the jinn learn truly only after an unrecoverable interval of humiliating labor, so belated knowledge carries the cost of prior misreading.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the eater as a counter-worker within a production ecology rather than merely a biological cause. It remains anchored in the earth-creature, eating, corrosive branch, driving staff, and the neighboring garden sequence of eating, yield, and replacement. Downstream prose should present it as a material-ecological analogy, not as a claim that the creature intentionally rebelled.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The earth-creature eats the staff whose preserved posture keeps the jinn at humiliating work.

activation_trace.role: Hidden creeping lets a negligible worker alter the system outside the notice of its visible workforce.
The wood-eating earth-creature grounds the reading in a concrete ecological agent.
Corrosive eating makes consumption the act that terminates the labor arrangement.
The eaten staff carries the driving function whose material removal ends discipline.
Commanded eating situates consumption within the neighboring ordered garden economy.
Fruit and yield supply the productive form of eating's object before ecological reversal.
One thing replacing another supplies the larger ecological reversal echoed by the staff's destruction.

changed_reading.before: The creature is a negligible biological cause in a royal death scene.
changed_reading.after: The earth-eater can be carried as an ecological counter-worker: unnoticed consumption redistributes agency and shuts down coerced production from below.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it hears tabayyanat al-jinn as disclosure about the jinn, not only cognition by them. It remains anchored in the B-Y-N appearance branch, the J-N-N hidden-being branch, and the following counterfactual that specifies their ignorance. Downstream prose should call this an exploratory grammatical-semantic echo, not replace the ordinary realization reading with a categorical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The construction tabayyanat al-jinn stands between the body's fall and the counterfactual denial that the jinn knew the unseen.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and uncovering permit the fall to disclose the jinn's condition as well as the death.
The concealed beings become the very object whose limitation is made visible.
Knowledge disclosed to a knower supplies the ordinary realization sense that the outlier retains rather than discards.
The hidden domain defines the limitation exposed by their prolonged labor.
Later naming the hidden beings as objects of worship raises the stakes of publicly exposing their limitation.

changed_reading.before: The fall only gives the jinn information about Solomon.
changed_reading.after: The fall also gives the audience information about the jinn: hidden beings become legible as ignorant of the hidden.

strongest_changes: The staff postpones recognition, not death, separating event time from disclosure time.
The immediate work-and-threat context identifies the prolonged humiliating punishment as coerced production sustained after living authority ends.
The Iblis passage makes authority behavioral: supposition and following can preserve effects even where actual power is absent.
The surah's opening and close turn the tiny material sign into a test of evidence against prestige, distance, and belated access.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context converted a marvel narrative into an inspectable mechanism linking microscopic decay, load-bearing material, worker belief, coercive labor, and the timing of knowledge while preserving the stranger ecological and self-exposing echoes as exploratory.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the repeated indication, fall, and sign language intentionally answers the mock guidance of 34:7.
Whether the Iblis model of influence without authority is meant to explain the jinn's continued labor or only parallels it.
Whether tabayyanat al-jinn can carry disclosure about the jinn alongside the ordinary sense that they realized.
How tightly the garden economy of 34:15-16 should be connected to the earth-creature's consumption.
